levels.surface: أبي محمد هارون بن موسى التلعكبري

notes: «أخبرنا جماعة» and «عن الثقة» are unnamed links at their places.

The parenthesis «وما رأيت أصدق لهجة منه ...» is a grader's remark inside the chain, not a link. The first-person account («دخلت على أبي محمد ... فهنأته») is Abu al-Fadl's own; Abu Muhammad, the Imam visited, is in the scene only and is not written as a link.
